mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates on future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the average 20-day return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (HOUST) above 1,400,000 units signals strong consumer confidence and rising household wealth, which drives equity market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1400.0, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 102.0 indicates weakening real economic activity, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 102.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals broad-based demand strength that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances where both HOUST > 1400.0 and RSAFS > 690000.0, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in CPIAUCSL above 3.0% combined with a stable FEDFUNDS rate signals persistent inflationary pressure that forces the Fed to delay rate cuts, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and FEDFUNDS <= 4.5%, or the joint signal fails to produce a statistically significant negative return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals labor market overheating, which increases the likelihood of Fed rate hikes and suppresses equity valuations over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5 and PAYEMS > 155000.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 695,000 million dollars combined with a stable GDP growth (GDPC1) signals resilient consumer demand that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS > 695000.0 and GDPC1 > 20150.0, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
